context: Ryosuke attends Sakura's first book signing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: さくら、人、並んでる、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura, look at all these people lined up.
lines.style: Warm, quiet pride threading through. Gentle opening on her name. Voice carries the soft wonder of a parent witnessing something they've helped nurture. No rush — letting the moment settle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Dad, I'm so glad you came.
lines.style: Tender, direct gratitude. Soft attack on the opening. Voice lifts slightly with genuine relief. Not performing — just the plain truth of being happy he's here.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Everyone really loves your work, you know.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Settling into the bigger picture. Warm tone, almost philosophical — noticing not just the people but what they represent. Slight pause before 'loves' like he's letting her hear it too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm truly grateful to all of them.
lines.style: Sincere, steady gratitude. Quiet intensity — not about performing thanks, but actually meaning it. Slight weight on 'truly.' Finishing thought trails softly, like she's taking it in.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 誇り、思ってる、本当に、お前。
lines.style: Direct, unhurried warmth. Light emphasis on 'really' — no hedging, just honest. Lean-in closeness without being loud. The voice of a parent who means exactly what he says and isn't afraid to say it plainly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの言葉、力に、なる。
lines.en: Your words mean everything to me.
lines.style: Quiet intensity, nearly vulnerable. Soft opening. Voice catches slightly on the weight of what she's saying. Not theatrical — the realness of a teenager letting a parent know he matters. Slight fade on the final word.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 一緒に、ずっと、応援、する。
lines.en: I'll always be right here cheering for you.
lines.style: Warm closing promise. Steady, unhurried pace. Emphasis settles on 'always' — a commitment without drama. Voice carries both present tenderness and forward-looking devotion. Soft, grounded finish.
